content: {"phoneNote":"The hero shows a misty forest valley instead of anything the carpenter makes, and the address and opening hours appear twice at the bottom of the page.","desktopNote":"The waiting-time card sits alone in the left half with a dead empty band beside it, and the contact block is repeated in the footer right after the contact cards.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":2},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":2},"fixes":["Replace the landscape hero with a photo of finished furniture or the workshop, and add a photo to each of the six product items so the page shows the trade instead of listing it.","Remove the footer 'Obiščite nas' and 'Delovni čas' blocks (or the contact cards above) so address and hours appear once.","On desktop, let the 'Čakalna doba' card span the full width or pair it with the wood photo; shrink the 1979 numeral and the gap below it so the story section does not read as a dead band."],"blockers":["Phone and desktop: address, directions link and opening hours are repeated in the footer directly after the 'Obiščite nas v delavnici' contact cards.","Desktop, waiting-time section: the card occupies only the left half, leaving the right half of the band empty."]}
